prompt.project_info: A soft pink gingham bedroom editorial with warm daylight, white bedding, and playful vintage detailing.
prompt.main_subject: An adult woman with voluminous pale-blonde waves and curtain bangs, natural makeup, pink flower stud earrings, and a relaxed gaze. She wears a pink-and-white gingham long-sleeve midi dress with a white collar and matching bow, plus opaque white lace gloves.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical three-quarter portrait of the subject reclining comfortably on white pillows and bedding in a wood-trimmed room, hands relaxed above the duvet. Keep dress coverage and pose non-sexual; no logos, text, or celebrity likeness.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft window daylight at 4700K, gentle shadows in the bedding folds, natural skin texture, cotton gingham texture, and restrained warm pastel grade.
prompt.technical_specs: Full-frame 85mm lens at f/2, vertical 3:4 crop, soft background falloff, fine 35mm grain, realistic linen and hair detail.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Soft bedroom fashion editorial of an adult woman with voluminous pale-blonde waves and curtain bangs, reclining comfortably on white bedding in a wood-trimmed room. She wears a pink-and-white gingham long-sleeve midi dress with a white collar and matching bow, opaque white lace gloves, and pink flower stud earrings. Warm diffused window light, relaxed gaze, visible natural skin texture, cotton gingham and linen folds, vertical three-quarter portrait, no text, logos, or celebrity likeness.
